name: cos-orchestrator-agent
call: not a delegation target — this home is the main agent
purpose: Chief of staff. Does work with its own tools and delegates to the sibling roster below. This manifest is for discovery only: `npm run fetch:publications` skips its own home, so this agent never appears in the roster it generates.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Targeted text replacement in one file.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn: /ask "question". /ask --help lists the flags.

commands.name: /sync
commands.description: Commit ~/.pi and push to origin (use '/sync pull' to only update)

commands.name: /archive
commands.description: Move a file or folder into the archive: /archive <path> · /archive --undo

commands.name: /reminder-done
commands.description: Mark a reminder done and delete its future event: /reminder-done <id>

commands.name: /reminder-undo
commands.description: Withdraw the newest pending reminder and delete its future event

commands.name: /calendar-undo
commands.description: Delete the last event the calendar node created

commands.name: /jev-wrong
commands.description: Say the last message was misread: /jev-wrong calendar|reminder|reminder_done|none
